# Rules

Everything this app's UI must not do, in one place. Read it before writing UI. A rule marked "review" has no script yet, so a reviewer checks it.

| ID | Rule | Answered on | Ground | Enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rule/arbitrary-value` | A Tailwind arbitrary value such as p-[13px] or bg-[#0f766e]. A transition property list, a CSS-wide keyword, a grid area name and math built only from tokens and env() pass | none yet |  | `scripts/check-system.mjs` |
| `rule/button-aria-label-value` | When a button's visible label is a value rather than its action, pass ariaLabel starting with the action and holding the visible text, and pass it on 0 other buttons, because a drawing's name alone is announced as "Bracket, button" with no action in it, while an aria-label over a verb label hides the word a speech-input user says to press it. | [components/button](docs/generated/components/button.md) | single use | test `src/ui/Button.test.tsx` |
| `rule/button-canonical-element` | When a surface needs a button, render Button rather than a raw <button> with its own class, because the replaced classes paint 6 different hover fills and 3 different radii by hand. | [components/button](docs/generated/components/button.md) | app | review `src/ui/Button.tsx` |
| `rule/button-disabled-reason` | When a button is disabled by something the user can fix, pass the reason as title in 1 short sentence, because a disabled button stays focusable and hoverable for exactly this and a dead button with 0 words leaves the user guessing what to fill in. | [components/button](docs/generated/components/button.md) | single use | test `src/ui/Button.test.tsx` |
| `rule/button-label-verb` | When the label is written, use a verb the user recognizes in sentence case — Save, Delete, Undo all — because the label is the action's name and the accessible name comes from it. | [components/button](docs/generated/components/button.md) | app | review `src/components/AssistantPane.tsx` |
| `rule/button-row-limit` | When one row or dialog footer holds more than 3 buttons, move the rest into a menu, because the measured composer toolbar holds 3 actions at 24px each and a fourth starts competing with the input. | [components/button](docs/generated/components/button.md) | measured | review `src/components/AssistantPane.tsx` |
| `rule/button-state-ladder` | When a button is hovered, step the fill one rung — .08 to .14 — and hold that rung while pressed, because the measured glass button adds no third step and a fill step reads as feedback without moving the label or the box. | [components/button](docs/generated/components/button.md) | measured | review `src/ui/ui.css` |
| `rule/button-title-adds` | When a button takes title, write what the label leaves out and 0 words that repeat it, because the label is the name and the hint is announced after it as the description: "Save, button, Save" says the same thing twice, and the layer draws no box for a repeat. | [components/button](docs/generated/components/button.md) | single use | test `src/ui/Button.test.tsx` |
| `rule/button-variant-purpose` | When a surface needs a button, pick variant by the action's purpose — 1 primary per view, secondary for the default, ghost for a quiet action, danger for a destructive one — because two accent fills in one row leave no single action and Cursor's own default button is the quiet one. | [components/button](docs/generated/components/button.md) | app | review `src/ui/ui.css` |
| `rule/checkbox-canonical-element` | When a surface needs a tick box, render Checkbox rather than a raw <input type="checkbox"> with accent-color, because the platform draws that box in its own shape, size and tick in each of the 3 system webviews the desktop app runs in. | [components/checkbox](docs/generated/components/checkbox.md) | single use | review `src/ui/Checkbox.tsx` |
| `rule/checkbox-label-inside` | When a checkbox has a visible label, pass the words as the children of Checkbox rather than as a sibling element, because the component's <label> wraps the box and the words, which makes all of them 1 target, and a sibling <span> leaves a dead gap that reads as broken. | [components/checkbox](docs/generated/components/checkbox.md) | single use | test `src/ui/Checkbox.test.tsx` |
| `rule/checkbox-label-positive` | When a checkbox's label is written, name what is true when the box is ticked, in 1 to 4 words in the positive form (Show the grid), because a ticked box beside a negative label has to be read twice. | [components/checkbox](docs/generated/components/checkbox.md) | single use | review `src/components/PropertiesPanel.tsx` |
| `rule/checkbox-mixed-three-states` | When one box stands for several objects, pass mixed while they disagree and set it to false in onChange, because the first press on a mixed box asks for ticked and all 3 states must be reachable: mixed to ticked, ticked to empty, empty to ticked. | [components/checkbox](docs/generated/components/checkbox.md) | single use | test `src/ui/Checkbox.test.tsx` |
| `rule/checkbox-name` | When a checkbox is rendered, give it a visible label as its children or, where the row already shows the name, an ariaLabel, because a box with neither is announced as 1 unnamed check box. | [components/checkbox](docs/generated/components/checkbox.md) | single use | test `src/ui/Checkbox.test.tsx` |
| `rule/checkbox-owns-nothing` | When onChange runs, set the caller's own value from its argument (or refuse it), because the box redraws from checked and mixed after every press and keeps 0 state of its own. | [components/checkbox](docs/generated/components/checkbox.md) | single use | test `src/ui/Checkbox.test.tsx` |
| `rule/checkbox-touch-target` | When checkboxes without labels stack in rows, keep the rows at least 24px apart centre to centre under a coarse pointer, because each 14px box takes a 24px target around its middle there and two targets in rows 22px apart overlap by 2px. | [components/checkbox](docs/generated/components/checkbox.md) | measured | review `src/ui/ui.css` |
| `rule/chip-canonical-element` | When a surface needs a chip, render Chip rather than a styled <span> or <button> with its own pill, because the replaced class hard-codes its own radius and hover and skips the static/interactive split. | [components/chip](docs/generated/components/chip.md) | app | review `src/ui/Chip.tsx` |
| `rule/chip-interactive-only-with-handler` | When a chip runs an action, pass onClick so it renders as a <button>; when it is a fact, pass nothing so it stays a <span>, because a fact in the tab order adds a stop that does nothing. | [components/chip](docs/generated/components/chip.md) | app | test `src/ui/Chip.test.tsx` |
| `rule/chip-row-limit` | When a chip row holds more than 6 chips, wrap the row or move the rest behind a "More" chip, because the measured chip is 20px tall with 8px side padding and a 608px composer row fits 6 of them before the row wraps. | [components/chip](docs/generated/components/chip.md) | measured | review `src/components/CommandLine.tsx` |
| `rule/chip-text-short` | When a chip's text is written, keep it to 1 word or a number plus its unit (26 objects, line, mm), because the pill is 20px tall and a third word starts wrapping the row. | [components/chip](docs/generated/components/chip.md) | single use | review `src/components/CommandLine.tsx` |
| `rule/chip-tone-meaning` | When a chip's tone is picked, use accent only for a keyword the user can pick and neutral for a value, because the accent tint is the app's signal for the accent role and 2 tinted chips in one row read as 2 selections. | [components/chip](docs/generated/components/chip.md) | app | review `src/ui/ui.css` |
| `rule/chip-touch-target` | When interactive chips sit in a row, keep at least 4px between them and between 2 rows of them, because under a coarse pointer each 20px pill keeps its drawn size and takes a 24px target from an invisible ::after 2px past every edge, and closer pills overlap their targets. | [components/chip](docs/generated/components/chip.md) | measured | review `src/ui/ui.css` |

| `rule/field-canonical-element` | When a surface needs a single-line input, render Field rather than a raw <input> with its own class, because the replaced classes paint 3 different heights and borders by hand. | [components/field](docs/generated/components/field.md) | app | review `src/ui/Field.tsx` |
| `rule/field-described-by` | When a line of help or an error sits under a field, give the line an id and pass it as describedBy, and pass invalid while the value is refused, because a line that only sits near the input is read 0 times by a screen reader that lands on the input by Tab. | [components/field](docs/generated/components/field.md), [components/select](docs/generated/components/select.md), [components/textarea](docs/generated/components/textarea.md) | single use | test `src/ui/Field.test.tsx` |

## What the check can't see

A reviewer or a browser covers these. Passing `cd apps/ui && bun run check` says nothing about them.

- Rendered contrast, including non-text contrast of borders, focus rings and checkbox edges. Measure it in a browser.
- Behavior: what a click, Enter or Escape does, focus order and focus return, and whether Cancel submits.
- Layout at each viewport, overflow at 390px and touch target sizes.
- Visual overrides on components the registry does not list, and overrides built at runtime: cn() branches, spread props, a class name held in a variable.
- A loading state shown some other way than a label ternary on the button, such as a label read from a variable.
- Class names and values built at runtime, such as template strings, cn() branches or fontSize: size / 2.5.
- bg-white and text-black when the theme defines no role for their job, their opacity forms such as bg-black/50, and CSS keywords such as white in var() fallbacks.
- Files outside the include folders, and ui files missing from the drift list (they are scanned, but no hash guards them).
- Whether a token's role comment still matches how the token is used.
- Rules the generated rules page marks review, or enforces only through their own Check: clause.
- Motion that is only measured: exit slower than enter, frequent-surface motion, linear easing, press delay, input lag and jank. Easing set in script or through a variable, and hover reveals written as Tailwind classes (v4 guards hover: itself, v3 does not).
- Whether a pressed style covers the control whose tap highlight was removed: any pressed style in the repo passes trap/touch-tap-highlight.
